title: Dart dependency declared as `any`
description: pubspec.yaml declares a pubspec dependency whose constraint is `any`. Every release satisfies the constraint, so `pub get` follows whatever the hosted server publishes next.
remediation: Declare the version constraint the project tested and commit `pubspec.lock`.
limitation: It matches a pubspec dependency whose constraint is `any` in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
